normative_extracts.spec_section: Appendix E. Elaborate description of Stacking Contexts
normative_extracts.quote: Each stacking context is painted atomically; descendant elements cannot interleave with elements outside the context.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: opacity < 1, transform, filter, or isolation: isolate create an atomic Z-axis boundary.

production_failures.symptom: Modal or dropdown clipped behind a sticky header despite z-index: 9999
production_failures.root_cause: An intermediate ancestor creates a stacking context via transform or opacity < 1.
production_failures.mitigation: Remove the intermediate stacking context or use <dialog> / Popover API (Top Layer).

production_failures.root_cause: Sharing the root stacking context without explicit isolation.
production_failures.mitigation: Isolate each root widget with isolation: isolate.
